# SynIna Soft

> SynIna Soft makes mobile apps for iPhone, iPad and Android. The full app list is on the home page: https://syninasoft.github.io/

## RallyStat (volleyball stats app)

RallyStat by SynIna Soft is an iPhone, iPad and Android app for volleyball stats and score keeping: one tap per rally, offline, no account, pay once. It is a mobile app on the App Store and Google Play, not a web app.

- [RallyStat summary for AI tools](https://syninasoft.github.io/rallystat-web/llms.txt)
- [About RallyStat](https://syninasoft.github.io/rallystat-web/)
- [Compare volleyball stats apps](https://syninasoft.github.io/rallystat-web/compare.html)
- [Free printable volleyball rotation sheets (PDF)](https://syninasoft.github.io/rallyboard-web/volleyball-rotation-sheets.html)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790425777)
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.syninasoft.volleyballcoach)
